requirements_summary: Need multi-region Dedicated pools: NA primary (2 AZs), EU secondary; target sustained throughput 1.2M tokens/min, burst 2M tokens/min for up to 5 minutes; latency SLOs p50 < 30ms, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 250ms for chat workflow under commit; failover headroom 25-35% per region; prefer reserved GPU counts with hot/warm pool split, preferring pre-warmed checkpointed models to reduce cold start to <5s.
poc_plan: 6-week POC: Week 1-2: capacity planning + infra mapping; Week 3: deploy dedicated pools in NA (2 AZs) and EU test region; Week 4: run synthetic load (traffic mix: 70% chat, 20% rerank, 10% embeddings) and measure p95/p99 and throughput; Week 5: implement warm-standby failover and model-variant fallback (quantized variant) and measure failover time; Week 6: deliver report + SLA recommendation. Success criteria: sustained throughput within 10% of target, p95 & p99 meet SLOs after mitigation, failover <5s without user-visible errors. SE to provide GPU count matrix (e.g., NA primary: 48 GPUs reserved across 2 AZs with 30% warm; EU secondary: 16 GPUs reserved with 35% warm).
